_comment_purpose: Contrastive encoder config (Ansatz A: Single Encoder + SupConLoss over all series). Recycles CNNAutoEncoder from anomaly_detection + adds projection head for SupCon loss.
_comment_variant_axes: Four fields define a variant and must be edited together when switching: (1) encoder_type — autoencoder vs classifier auxiliary head; (2) selected_features — feature group (G5 raw / G6 diff / G7 echo / G8 TC); (3) output_root — artefact folder, keep per variant to avoid overwrite; (4) study_name — Optuna SQLite study, also per variant.
_comment_encoder_type: 'autoencoder' = MSE reconstruction + SupCon; 'classifier' = CE cross-entropy + SupCon. Both use the same CNN encoder + projection head; they differ only in auxiliary head and loss.
_comment_contrastive_loss: Which contrastive loss rides on top of the auxiliary head: 'supcon' (class-based, discrete labels), 'rnc' (Rank-N-Contrast on a continuous target — see rnc_target), 'both' (weighted sum), or 'none'. RNC requires processed CSVs for per-series target lookup.
_comment_rnc_target: Continuous per-series target for RNC. 'temp_pipe' (recommended) = mean pipe temperature over noflow+equilibrium+valid rows. 'temp_amb' / 'temp_diff' analogous; 'series_index' is the ordinal fallback.
_comment_study_name: Optuna study name. Pair with output_root (same suffix) so separate variants produce independent SQLite studies.
_comment_arch: Two backbone axes: encoder_arch selects CNN vs Transformer; encoder_type selects AE vs Classifier aux head. CNN stays at AD baseline for comparability; Transformer is the new parallel variant. Only SupCon/latent/batch hyperparams are tuned for CNN; transformer adds d_model/num_heads/num_layers/ff_dim/transformer_dropout to the search space.
_comment_transformer: Transformer-specific defaults (used when encoder_arch='transformer'). Override per run via CLI or Optuna. num_heads must divide d_model — all defaults in d_model=[64,128,256] × num_heads=[2,4,8] satisfy this.
_comment_cnn_channel_mode: 'dual' splits features as up|down. Only meaningful when the feature set is symmetric up/down. For G9 (all already combined) use 'single'. Override per run with --cnn-channel-mode.
_comment_features: Select feature group by replacing the list below. Presets: Gruppe 5 = norm_interval_up/down_0..8 (18 raw); Gruppe 6 = norm_interval_diff_0..8 (9 diff); Gruppe 7 = echo_ratio_0..8 (9 echo); Gruppe 8 = norm_interval_up/down_0..8_tc (18 TC).
_comment_supcon: Defaults used when NOT running Optuna tune. tune overrides these. lambda_rnc / rnc_temperature only have effect when contrastive_loss includes 'rnc'. lambda_deepsad / deepsad_margin / deepsad_repulsion_weight only have effect when contrastive_loss='deepsad'.
_comment_deepsad: DeepSAD loss defaults. lambda_deepsad = outer weight multiplying L_deepsad in the total loss. deepsad_margin = inner sphere radius m (distances in [0,4] for L2-normalised z_proj). deepsad_repulsion_weight = inner λ on L_repulse (not tuned by Optuna; fixed at 1.0).
_comment_optuna: Search space for --run tune. 200 trials recommended.

optuna_search_space._comment_transformer_search: Sampled only when encoder_arch='transformer'. num_heads=[2,4,8] all divide d_model=[64,128,256]; a runtime guard in train.py re-selects if divisibility fails.
optuna_search_space._comment_deepsad_search: Tuned when contrastive_loss='deepsad'. lambda_deepsad log-sampled; deepsad_margin linear. deepsad_repulsion_weight is NOT tuned (fixed at deepsad_repulsion_weight above).

_comment_eval: Test series used as Optuna target (research setting - generalization to spring drift is the research question). NOTE: this field is currently documentation-only — actual test assignment comes from splits.json (configs/preparation/splitting.json). Keep in sync. Final LOSO rotates all 8 series.
_comment_split_overrides: Decouple encoder training from GMM eval. Both default to splits.json's train_series/test_series. Set encoder_train_series and gmm_eval_series to null (or omit) for legacy behaviour. Override via CLI: --encoder-train-series, --gmm-eval-series. See CLAUDE.md §'Eval recipes'.
_comment_gmm_eval_mode: GMM strategy. 'per_series' fits a fresh GMM per eval series on that site's own NoFlow (optimistic, recalibration assumed). 'global' fits ONE GMM on encoder-train NoFlow latents and scores all eval series with it (pessimistic, no recalibration — deployment-realistic). 'global_conditional' fits a linear regression z~T_pipe on train NoFlow + GMM on residuals (embeds drift model into scoring; tests linear-extrapolation of NoFlow centroid). 'both' = per_series + global. 'all' = all three. Override via CLI: --gmm-eval-mode.
_comment_gmm_temp_target: Temperature signal used by global_conditional GMM. 'temp_pipe' is the strongest predictor per drift analysis (Spearman 0.95). Override via CLI: --gmm-temp-target.
_comment_loso: All Haus A series excluding 30.03 (estimated labels, not trusted). ha-24.05 is confirmed NoFlow-only (0 leakage + 6 no_leakage) — contributes training data for other folds but is skipped in the AUC aggregate when held out. ha-20.06 was NoFlow-only before the 2026-07-09 label fix (06_18/06_20 corrected to leakage per data/raw/descriptions/ha-20.06.2026.txt) and is now AUC-computable (2 leakage + 2 no_leakage). ha-9.05 labels remain disputed (see git history — flagged 'possibly corrupted', processed:true skip) and have no processed/prepared data as of this writing, so it contributes nothing to any fold until resolved. All hb- series excluded — separate drift axis.
_comment_chrono: chrono_extrap / chrono_extrap_temp / chrono_extrap_pooled: walk-forward chronological extrapolation, NOT leave-one-out. Uses chrono_series below (NOT loso_series) because order matters here and loso_series has a bug: ha-6.06.2026 (Jun 3-6) is listed BEFORE ha-2.06.2026 (Jun 1-2), which is backwards. Harmless for LOSO (order-independent, every fold's pool is 'all others' regardless of order) but silently mislabeled two splits in the first chrono_extrap run (2026-07-12, results/chronological_extrapolation) before this was caught on 2026-07-13. chrono_series here is the corrected order. For each split index k from chrono_min_train to len(chrono_series)-1: train on chrono_series[0:k]; chrono_extrap/chrono_extrap_temp test on the single next series chrono_series[k], chrono_extrap_pooled tests on ALL remaining series chrono_series[k:] pooled together (matches the supervisor's sketch: train 1-4/test 5-9, train 1-5/test 6-9, ...). Override the starting window via --chrono-min-train, or run a subset via --chrono-test-series.
_comment_gmm: Anomaly scoring in latent space. Fit on held-out NoFlow only (deployment simulation).
_comment_checkpoints: Keep top-N trial weights for later ablation.
